title.en: Amending Presidential Decree No. 1251 Imposing a Fee on Operating Mining Companies to Be Known as "Mine Wastes and Tailing Fee" to Compensate for Damages to Private Land-Owners and for Other Purposes

text.en:
The Committee created under Presidential Decree No. 1251 and its Staff are hereby entitled to
actual field and travel expenses and monthly allowance in an amount not exceeding P300,000.00 annually to
be taken from the reserve fund.

The Committee created under Presidential Decree No. 1251 is hereby expanded to include the
Director of the Bureau of Soils as Members thereof.

If any section or provision of this Decree is held unconstitutional or invalid by a competent
court, the other sections or provisions so annulled or voided had never been incorporated in this Decree;

All laws, executive orders, decrees, rules and regulations or part thereof, contrary to or
inconsistent with the provisions of this Decree, are hereby repealed and amended or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately upon promulgation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 8th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty.
